source_findings: Actual pgmpy1.1.2 DiscreteBayesianNetwork, TabularCPD and two VariableElimination.query calls.
Explicit binary state names and CPD parameter/parent order match the specification.
Unconditional joint sensor factor supplies positive mass before conditioned posterior inference.
Both raw posterior entries are finite probabilities and normalized at1e-12 before uniform .15g conversion of both outputs.
Expected constants are confined to documentation; calculate has no answer-specific branch, fixture detection or handwritten Bayes replacement.
Opaque transport precision is preserved and actual UTC is recorded after computation.
limits: No collector execution or affirmative argument review is supplied by this audit.
Finite cases and source inspection do not establish universal ill-conditioned-input accuracy or arbitrary near-threshold stability.
Posterior is conditional on the specified model, not empirical fault rates or real-world causal validity.

binding_digest_interpretation: The observed tool_binding_digest is a host store-keyed HMAC, not a publicly recomputable file SHA256. This audit independently verifies declared file SHA256 pins and dependency copies; native acquisition validates binding pins before and after execution. Private store keys were not read.
